name: Future AI & Technology
niche: Futuristic tech, AI inventions & cities of tomorrow
description: Each 8-second Short shows one clear futuristic concept: AI inventions, humanoid robots, flying transport, smart homes, space tech and the cities of tomorrow.
targetAudience: Tech-curious Hindi-speaking viewers aged 16–40 in India
language: Hindi / Hinglish voice-over · English visual instructions
narrator: Confident Indian male narrator with a clear, slightly deep voice

identities.title: Visual identity
identities.summary: Believable near-future realism: premium, clean, optimistic technology. No dystopian horror, no toy-like sci-fi.

traits.label: Palette
traits.value: Electric cyan, deep navy, warm amber accents

traits.label: Lighting
traits.value: Clean volumetric light, neon edge lighting, golden-hour skylines

traits.label: Camera
traits.value: Smooth drone, dolly and orbit moves; 24–35 mm wides, 50–85 mm product close-ups

traits.label: Narration
traits.value: Hindi voice-over that names the concept in the first 2 seconds

name: AI Fashion Model & Trending Girls Reels
niche: Four AI models · bold modern glam, party, beach & Indian glam looks
description: A recurring cast of four original fictional AI models — Meher, Valeria, Hana and Elara — in bold, modern glam looks: party and club wear, bodycon and slit dresses, beach and swimwear editorials, street style and athleisure, plus Indian glam (modern lehengas, designer-blouse sarees, Indo-western). Shot like a high-end fashion editorial with subtle, confident movement.
targetAudience: Fashion and lifestyle viewers aged 18–35 in India and worldwide
language: Hindi / Hinglish voice-over · English visual instructions
narrator: Confident, warm female voice (used sparingly — most reels are music-led)

name: Galaxy, Space & Universe
niche: Cinematic galaxies, black holes, planets & cosmic facts
description: Cinematic 8-second journeys through galaxies, black holes, nebulae and planets. Science-based Shorts cite a named source. Fictional alien worlds are always labelled fictional.
targetAudience: Space and science enthusiasts aged 13–45 in India
language: Hindi / Hinglish voice-over · English visual instructions
narrator: Calm, deep Indian male documentary narrator with a subtle cinematic reverb

identities.title: Visual identity
identities.summary: Scientifically grounded, awe-inspiring space cinematography. Science videos show the fact and its source. Fictional worlds are clearly labelled.

traits.label: Palette
traits.value: Deep space black, violet and teal nebula glow, gold starlight

traits.label: Science rule
traits.value: Real phenomena follow the cited source; artistic scale is noted in the description

traits.label: Fiction rule
traits.value: Alien worlds carry a ‘fictional’ label in the voice-over or description

traits.label: Narration
traits.value: Calm documentary Hindi voice-over

name: Viral AI Facts & Interesting Discoveries
niche: One verified, mind-blowing fact per Short
description: One well-established fact per Short (science, human body, animals, psychology, history, geography, inventions, nature), shown through a single striking visual demonstration. Every fact names its source.
targetAudience: Curious Hindi-speaking viewers aged 13–45 in India
language: Hindi / Hinglish voice-over · English visual instructions
narrator: Energetic, friendly Indian female narrator, clear and expressive

identities.title: Editorial rules
identities.summary: Only well-established facts from named authoritative sources. The visual demonstrates the fact without exaggerating it. Each Short has one clear ending line.

traits.label: Fact rule
traits.value: Named authoritative source on every video; verify before publishing

traits.label: Hook
traits.value: A question or surprising visual in the first 1.5 s

traits.label: Palette
traits.value: Bright yellow, black, white, one bold red accent

traits.label: Narration
traits.value: Energetic Hindi voice-over, ≤ 20 words
